시편 87:1.content: A Psalm or Song for the sons of Korah. His foundation is in the holy mountains.

시편 87:2.content: The Lord loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

시편 87:3.content: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.

시편 87:4.content: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.

시편 87:5.content: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.

시편 87:6.content: The Lord shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.

시편 87:7.content: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.
